promise: Halve the proportion of people living in extreme poverty between 1990 and 2015
description: The MDG target was to halve the extreme-poverty proportion between 1990 and 2015. The UN's 2015 report said the target was achieved and estimated the developing-world rate fell from 47% to 14%.
evidence: UN 2015 report gives 47% and 14% for developing regions, using its then-current $1.25-a-day measure.
sources: United Nations Millennium Development Goals Report

review.note: 47% to 14% refers to developing regions, not global population. Goal success supported by UN report; exact September 8 adoption and 189 signatories require declaration.

promise: We will end Boko Haram by December
description: In July 2015, shortly after his inauguration, Buhari promised that the Boko Haram insurgency would be 'technically ended' by December 2015, saying the military had been ordered to defeat the group within months. The insurgency continued throughout his entire eight-year presidency, with attacks and kidnapping persisting long after the deadline.
evidence: Boko Haram attacks continued past the December 2015 deadline and throughout Buhari's term
Buhari's own defense officials later abandoned the 'technical defeat' claim

review.note: December deadline and continuing attacks are supported; July 14 announcement and 'technically ended' as original promise are unverified. Later declaration of technical defeat must not be backdated into the pledge.

promise: Yellen said most FOMC participants expected conditions to warrant raising rates later in 2015 (conditional forecast, paraphrase).
description: The FOMC raised the federal-funds target range by 25 basis points on 16 December 2015, to 0.25-0.50%.
evidence: The December 16, 2015 rate increase occurred within the conditional forecast's year-end window.
sources: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

promise: Plan a German federal budget without new borrowing in 2015
description: Schaeuble presented the no-new-borrowing plan on March 12, 2014, applying from 2015.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the dated government announcement establishes the 2015 target, but the original multi-year outturn claims were not verified.

promise: HP revenue would stabilize in 2014, with growth accelerating again in 2015
description: Whitman said in October 2013 that HP expected revenue to stabilize in fiscal 2014 and accelerate in fiscal 2015. HP's fiscal 2014 fourth-quarter revenue fell 2% year over year; it did not report growth in both Q3 and Q4.
evidence: Q3 and Q4 FY2014 quarterly revenue grew year over year
Full-year FY2014 revenue still declined slightly; 2015 split disrupted the growth plan

review.note: Contemporaneous report is October 9, not October 1, 2013. Q4 2014 revenue declined 2%, contradicting two consecutive growth quarters. Targets are fiscal years, so calendar December 2015 is not automatically the deadline. FY2015 outcome and precise fiscal deadline remain unresolved.
